The Mother
Juhu. A white mansion with a gate taller than a bus. A maid leads you past forty framed posters of Tara, all from films she hated.
Sit. Tea? No? Good. Let's not pretend we like each other.
A fake marriage. How clever. Clause seven. How sweet. Do you know what happens if this leaks? Her career ends. Yours too.
I won't leak it. On two conditions. You sign my production house as your personal sponsor. And Tara's next three films are mine to choose.
Tara's next three films. Her whole life, decided in this room.
"No. Tara chooses her own films."
Stand up for her.
"I'll sign the sponsorship. Leave her films alone."
Compromise.
Record this conversation on your phone.
Insurance.
Half a deal. I'll take it. For now.
Your thumb finds the record button. She keeps talking. Every word.
Think about it. You're not as clever as my daughter, and she isn't very clever.
Brave. My husband was brave. Look where it got him.
You met her? ALONE? I made you promise!
Tell her everything Sushma said.
No secrets.
"She just wanted tea."
Protect her from it.
...She did that to my father too. Business deals with his name on them. That's why he...
Captain. Series schedule's out.
First match Saturday. Mumbai.
Board says your wife MUST be in the stands. Kiss-cam and everything. Sorry.
Tara Kapoor has never watched a cricket match. On Saturday she has to watch sixty thousand people watching her.
